author: Parshall, Jonathan; Tully, Anthony
title: Shattered Sword: The Untold Story of the Battle of Midway
notes: Midway rebuilt from the Japanese records — kodōchōsho action reports, the Senshi Sōsho, the ships' own damage narratives. It dismantles the version that came down through Fuchida (the "five fateful minutes", the decks packed with fuelled aircraft) and is the study to cite for anything about Nagumo, Yamaguchi or the Kidō Butai.
